# Third-party dependencies

- Transformer Formal Languages uses the reviewed [upstream repository](https://github.com/satwik77/Transformer-Formal-Languages)
  at the commit in [tfl.commit](tfl.commit). `setup.sh formal` downloads it with its MIT license.
- RetNet installs the pinned [Flash Linear Attention](https://github.com/fla-org/flash-linear-attention)
  and [einops](https://github.com/arogozhnikov/einops) distributions through `setup.sh retnet`.
- Vendored S4D and Hyena retain their [S4](../proxy_tasks/common_set/licenses/s4-LICENSE) and
  [Safari](../proxy_tasks/common_set/licenses/safari-LICENSE) notices.
- Genomics and Bach data origins and license terms are in the [Drive manifest](../drive_upload_20261123/README.md).
